en: Sepia-toned vintage street scene in a European city, showing a narrow plaza or intersection lined with multi‑story masonry buildings with shutters and awnings. A distinctive overhanging corner house supported by arches dominates the center-left. In the middle of the square stands a small kiosk-like structure with a domed or cage-like top. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand near the buildings and kiosk. The card has a printed border but no visible caption or writing on the image side.
